observations.summary: Drainfield is a shallow covered excavation in unsaturated soil with perforated pipes or chambers; soil accepts, treats and disperses wastewater, removing coliform bacteria, viruses and nutrients; an overloaded drainfield can flood, sending sewage to the ground surface or causing backups in toilets and sinks.

Do not park or drive on the drainfield; plant trees an appropriate distance away; keep roof drains and sump pumps away; excess water slows or stops treatment; all laundry in one day could flood the drainfield; tank outlet keeps sludge and scum out of the drainfield; garbage disposals can push solids into the drainfield and clog pipes.
